description: This script determines the source date epoch of a given source directory or file by checking for version files, version control history (git or hg), or modification time. It outputs the epoch timestamp used for reproducible builds or timestamp tracking.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for a version.date file in the source directory and reads its content as the date epoch.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Uses git to retrieve the last commit timestamp for the source directory.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Uses hg (Mercurial) to retrieve the last commit date for the source directory.

methods.name: try_mtime
methods.description: Uses Perl to get the modification time of the current script file.
